ap_biology-m01.stem: The graph shows the mean beak depth of a population of finches measured in the year before a drought and in the year after the drought. Which of the following best describes the data in the graph?

data.title: Mean beak depth before and after a drought

options.text: The mean beak depth was the same in the two years that were measured.
options.why: The two bars have different heights.

options.text: The mean beak depth was greater after the drought than before the drought.
options.why: The bar for the year after the drought is taller than the bar for the year before.

options.text: The mean beak depth was smaller after the drought than before the drought.
options.why: The bar after the drought has the greater height.

options.text: Each bird's own beak grew larger during the drought, and so the mean rose.
options.why: The graph shows the mean of the population and not the change in any one bird.

facts: The graph shows the mean beak depth of a population of finch
